unit: SDK Abstractions freeze and ApiCompat report
notes: Moves the p6-006/p6-007 host surfaces into Playnite.SDK.Abstractions as a real move, not a redefinition: INotificationsAPI, IDialogsFactory, IMainViewAPI, IUriHandlerAPI, their host seams and every DTO now live in Playnite.SDK (Playnite.SDK.Descriptions for the HTML contracts, Playnite.SDK.Events for PlayniteUriEventArgs, Playnite.SDK.Models for IGameView/SortOrder/LibraryGroupBy); the concrete services stay in Core. IMainViewAPI is reshaped off the Core Game type through the abstraction-level IGameView, which Core Game implements, and MainViewState keeps every shell field and validation. Freezes the result: 62 exported types, 603 declarations, Shipped unchanged and the moved surface declared in Unshipped; the binary baseline is regenerated. The reviewed v6-to-v7 Microsoft.DotNet.ApiCompat 11.0.100 report now has 306 differences (208 CP0001, 82 CP0002, 15 CP0006, 1 CP0009) against the published PlayniteSDK 6.18.0 baseline (package sha256 63ae943bf226a782738d3d6b9977dcb77861e5d2ea1aadcf620332618c93e236), each classified in p6-008-apicompat-classification.tsv as adapted (114), deferred (178) or excluded (14), with the 98 moved/reshaped member breaks justified one per row; p6-008-apicompat-suppressions.xml replays to a clean ApiCompat exit 0. Adds 13 fake-host contract tests, one per interface, plus a sample-plugin compile check that references the Abstractions assembly alone. Verifies Core references only Playnite.SDK.Abstractions and neither Core nor Abstractions has a direct or transitive Avalonia/UI dependency. No protected oracle or aggregate edit; the PublicAPI/api-baseline change is the authorised oracle-change surface of this unit.
